apps.help: The app in front gets the time, in focus or not, unless you haven't touched the keyboard or mouse for a minute. Websites are timed by the Chrome extension: the active tab of the browser window you're in, so they are part of your browser's time above. It all stays on this PC, in app_time.json and site_time.json.
